differential: sublation preserves what it negates while elevating it; supersession implies mere replacement; transcendence lacks the moment of preservation
spirit (Geist) is self-developing rational actuality, not subjective mind or religious soul; it includes objective institutions and absolute self-knowledge

alienation (Entfremdung) is the structural separation of workers from their product/activity/species-being; estrangement is near-identical but externalization (Entaeusserung) emphasizes voluntary self-expression
Dasein is not a synonym for human being but designates the entity for whom Being is an issue; existence in the existentialist sense is closer but lacks the ontological priority
thing-in-itself is the object independent of sensibility; noumenon is the positive concept of an object of non-sensible intuition — Kant warns against conflating the two
jouissance exceeds the pleasure principle into painful excess; pleasure (Lust/plaisir) operates within homeostatic regulation; surplus-enjoyment (plus-de-jouir) is the specific object-cause of desire
will to power is not desire for domination but the internal principle of self-overcoming in all life; drive is too mechanistic; creative force lacks the agonistic dimension
deconstruction is not destruction or analysis; it traces internal contradictions that a text suppresses, showing how binary oppositions undermine themselves
episteme is the unconscious structure conditioning all knowledge in an epoch; paradigm (Kuhn) is a disciplinary matrix within a science; worldview is too subjective and voluntarist
dialectic is the self-movement of the concept through contradiction; method implies external application; logic in the Hegelian sense is identical with dialectic, not formal logic
commodity fetishism is the specific illusion whereby social relations between people appear as relations between things; reification (Lukacs) generalizes this to all rationalized social forms
being-toward-death is Dasein's ownmost possibility that individualizes and discloses authentic temporality; mortality is ontic fact; finitude is broader than death alone
the categorical imperative is the supreme principle of morality commanding unconditionally; moral law is near-identical; duty (Pflicht) is action from respect for the law, not the law itself
objet a is not a desired object but the void-cause that sets desire in motion; lost object suggests something once possessed; lack is the structural condition, not the object itself
eternal recurrence is the supreme test of affirmation — willing the identical return of each moment; cyclical time is cosmological; amor fati is the attitude, not the thought-experiment

differance (with an a) is neither a word nor a concept but the condition of possibility of all signification — the simultaneous differing and deferring that precedes presence; difference is merely oppositional
biopower targets the population as biological species (birth rates, health, longevity); disciplinary power targets individual bodies; governmentality is the broader rationality of rule
absolute knowing is spirit's complete self-transparency where substance is fully subject; it is not omniscience but the form in which all content is grasped as self-mediated
surplus value is the difference between value produced by labor and value of labor-power; profit is the phenomenal form that obscures its origin; exploitation is the social relation, not the quantity
thrownness is Dasein's finding itself always already in a situation not of its choosing; facticity is broader (includes all non-chosen givenness); contingency lacks the existential weight
transcendental idealism holds that space and time are forms of intuition, not things in themselves; critical idealism is synonymous; Kantianism is the broader movement including ethics and aesthetics
the Real is what resists symbolization absolutely — it is not reality (which is Imaginary-Symbolic construction) but the traumatic kernel that disrupts all representation

Ubermensch is the one who overcomes nihilism by creating new values after the death of God; superman carries unwanted connotations of biological superiority; free spirit is an earlier, less radical figure

the supplement adds to something supposedly complete, thereby revealing its originary incompleteness; addition implies a self-sufficient whole; replacement implies substitution without the logic of originary lack

the panopticon is an architectural diagram of power producing self-discipline through the possibility of being observed; surveillance is the broader practice; panopticism is the generalized social principle

determinate negation preserves the specific content of what is negated and produces a positive result; abstract negation annihilates content entirely; sublation is the broader process that includes determinate negation
class consciousness (Lukacs/Marx) is the objective standpoint a class would hold if it grasped its historical situation; class awareness is merely empirical recognition of class membership
ready-to-hand (zuhanden) is the primary mode of encountering equipment in absorbed coping; present-at-hand (vorhanden) is the derivative theoretical stance; useful is too instrumentalist

synthetic a priori judgments extend knowledge (synthetic) yet hold necessarily (a priori); analytic a priori is trivially true; synthetic a posteriori is contingent — the question of how synthetic a priori is possible defines critical philosophy

the mirror stage is the formative moment when the infant identifies with its reflected image, producing the ego as an imaginary unity masking bodily fragmentation; ego formation is the result, not the event
ressentiment is the creative-reactive force of the weak that inverts noble values by declaring strength evil; ordinary resentment lacks this value-creating inversion and metaphysical dimension

logocentrism is the privileging of speech/presence/logos over writing/absence/difference throughout Western metaphysics; phonocentrism is one aspect (speech over writing); onto-theology (Heidegger) identifies the theological structure

discourse is not language in general but a historically specific system of statements constituting objects of knowledge and subject positions; language is the general medium; narrative implies temporal sequencing

contradiction for Hegel is the motor of dialectical development, internal to the concept itself; formal logic treats contradiction as error to be eliminated; antinomy (Kant) is a specific form of irresolvable opposition between equally valid proofs

praxis is sensuous human activity that transforms both world and agent — the unity of theory and practice; practice without theory is blind; action (Arendt) is political speech-deed distinct from labor

authenticity is Dasein's owning its thrown possibilities rather than fleeing into das Man; genuineness implies sincerity of feeling; resoluteness (Entschlossenheit) is the concrete mode of authentic existence

antinomy is the conflict between two equally demonstrable yet mutually exclusive propositions arising from reason's overreach; paradox is broader; aporia (Derrida) emphasizes undecidability rather than demonstrability
the Symbolic is the register of language, law, and signification that structures all human experience; language is its medium but not identical to it; the big Other is the Symbolic as locus of speech

genealogy traces the contingent historical emergence of values and institutions, exposing their non-necessary origin in power relations; history (conventional) assumes continuity; archaeology (Foucault) examines discursive conditions of possibility
pharmakon is undecidably both remedy and poison, exposing the binary opposition health/illness as unstable; remedy or poison alone suppresses this constitutive ambiguity

heterotopia is a real space that functions as a counter-site inverting or contesting the spaces it mirrors (prisons, cemeteries, ships); utopia is a non-place; liminal space lacks the institutional specificity

mediation is the self-relating negativity through which immediacy is both negated and preserved in a higher unity; intermediation suggests an external agent; reconciliation is the result of mediation, not mediation itself

use value is the qualitative capacity of a commodity to satisfy a human need; utility (marginalist) is subjective preference ordering; use value is the material substrate that exchange value abstracts from

care (Sorge) is the fundamental ontological structure of Dasein as ahead-of-itself-already-in-the-world; concern (Besorgen) is care directed at equipment; solicitude (Fuersorge) is care directed at others

phenomena are objects as they appear to us conditioned by forms of intuition and categories; appearances is near-identical; representations (Vorstellungen) is broader, including concepts; sensory data lacks the role of a priori synthesis

the Name-of-the-Father is the fundamental signifier that anchors the symbolic order and institutes the law of prohibition; the paternal function is the structural role, not necessarily the empirical father; foreclosure of this signifier produces psychosis

perspectivism holds that all knowledge is interpretation from a particular vantage driven by will to power; relativism implies all views are equal; perspectivism ranks perspectives by their life-affirming power

iterability is the structural possibility of every sign to be repeated in new contexts, altering its meaning — this is constitutive, not accidental; repeatability suggests sameness; iterability insists on alteration-in-repetition

power-knowledge names the inseparability of power relations and knowledge production — power produces knowledge and knowledge enables power; ideology (Marxist) implies false consciousness obscuring truth; hegemony (Gramsci) emphasizes consent
